payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each time modulo c+1, precompute a 2D grid of star brightnesses, then build 2D prefix sums via DP recurrence, and answer rectangle queries in O(1).
payload.rationale: Uses 2D prefix sums computed with dp[t][x][y] = dp[t][x-1][y] + dp[t][x][y-1] - dp[t][x-1][y-1] + g[t][x][y], a classic DP pattern on a 2D state space across time steps.
